result: Product convolution approximants preserve density cap one and converge in product L1/TV.
Uniform interval bounds pass under TV to Borel domination and an essential L-infinity density cap.
Uniform equicontinuity passes separately to a canonical C0 representative; interval bounds alone do not imply continuity.
Account01/B15 Fresnel half-Holder estimates therefore hold for arbitrary rough cap-one inputs without pointwise trace evaluation.
remaining_gap: From s_3(A)>=1 alone, extract a universal product-preserving height receiver. Full QFORM and unrestricted continuity remain open.
